title: AURA: Intent-Directed Probing for Implicit-Need Surfacing in Situated LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.05557v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A situated query like "where is Lin Wei?" often encodes more than its literal content: the user may also want to know whether Lin Wei is free, in a good mood, or worth interrupting now. Standard tool-use agents answer the literal question and stop. AURA inserts an inference step between scene perception and tool use that produces an IntentFrame: a structured estimate of the implicit need with a scalar gap score that controls per-query probe budget and tool selection. On a 100-query four-scene implicit-intent benchmark, AURA improves implicit-need coverage over ReAct-style probing (Delta = +0.07, p < 10^-6); three of four scenes are individually significant, the gain reproduces on a second backbone, and a prompt ablation attributes the lift to gap calibration rather than answer memorisation. translated_title: AURA：面向情境化LLM智能体隐式需求挖掘的意图导向探测
translated_abstract: 像“林伟在哪里？”这样的情境化查询往往蕴含着超出字面内容的信息：用户可能还想了解林伟是否空闲、心情是否良好、或者现在是否值得去打扰。标准的工具调用型智能体只会回答字面问题便停止。AURA在场景感知与工具调用之间插入一个推理步骤，生成一个IntentFrame（意图框架）：一种对隐式需求的结构化估计，并带有标量差距分数，用于控制每个查询的探测预算与工具选择。在一个包含100个查询、四个场景的隐式意图基准测试中，AURA在隐式需求覆盖率上超越了ReAct风格的探测方法（Delta = +0.07，p < 10^-6）；四个场景中有三个单独达到统计显著，该增益在第二个骨干模型上得到复现，且提示消融实验将这一提升归因于差距校准而非答案记忆。组件消融进一步定位了增益来源：仅凭差距推导的预算上限就优于完整架构（p = 0.02），并且分箱……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AURA通过在场景感知与工具调用之间插入意图推理步骤，生成带差距分数的IntentFrame来挖掘情境化查询背后的隐式需求，其隐式需求覆盖率显著优于ReAct式探测方法。
en_tdlr: AURA inserts an intent-inference step between scene perception and tool use, producing a gap-scored IntentFrame that surfaces users' implicit needs in situated LLM agents and significantly outperforms ReAct-style probing in implicit-need coverage.
